articles.title: U.S. judge says Ethereum has ‘no terms of use,’ clears MIT brothers of $25 million fraud
articles.description: A federal judge acquitted Anton and James Peraire-Bueno, ruling that their 2023 trade against Ethereum trading bots involved no lie that anyone relied on, and closing the U.S. government’s first criminal case over the practice known as MEV.

articles.title: Iran says army targets U.S. drone and missile sites in Kuwait as Gulf attacks mount
articles.description: Iran said its army targeted U.S. drone and missile installations at Kuwait's Ali Al Salem air base, extending a run of attacks on Gulf states.

articles.title: 'Who and what comes next': Analysts expect Nvidia investor uncertainty despite earnings beat
articles.description: Nvidia’s Q3 results should help ease short-term concerns, but uncertainty remains around long-term leadership.

articles.title: Bitcoin's 12% slide through key support looks scary, but history says give it 3 months.
articles.description: Bitcoin broke below its 200-week average with a 12% drop. Only three similar crashes have occurred since 2013. Here’s what happened next.

articles.title: XRP whales moved $270 million during the selloff. The coins didn’t go to exchanges
articles.description: A holder whose wallets trace back to a 2020 Bitstamp withdrawal has moved 281 million XRP into two vaults three weeks apart, a behavior indicative of custody rather than a large investor heading for the exit.

articles.title: Putin says EU is losing industry, falling behind competition ahead of meeting with Trump, Xi
articles.description: Putin used the speech to emphasize Russia's economic resilience despite U.S. sanctions, and played up opportunities for APEC members in the country.

articles.title: Democrat Mary Peltola wins Alaska Senate election
articles.description: Peltola's defeat of incumbent Republican Dan Sullivan gives Democrats a solid majority of 56 seats in the Senate as of January.

articles.title: China’s Xi calls for removing trade and investment barriers ahead of his meeting with Trump and Putin
articles.description: Xi opened the APEC summit in Shenzhen by calling for lower trade and investment barriers, pledging broader access to China’s market and manufacturing sector.

articles.title: Three things to watch as Trump, Xi and Putin meet in China
articles.description: U.S. President Donald Trump, Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin are set to meet in Shenzhen alongside an APEC leaders' meeting.

articles.title: JPMorgan is working on AI agent transactions that don’t involve humans
articles.description: JPMorgan and Hyundai Card are looking to expand the use of AI agents in financial transactions.

articles.title: Zelenskyy says Starshield speed curbs still in place over 'occupied territories' of Ukraine
articles.description: Ukraine's charge d'affaires to the U.S., Denys Sienik, said that Starshield had been speed-limited for seven days already in Ukraine.

articles.title: Ledger hardware implant saga reaches Dubai’s Virgin Megastore
articles.description: Two Ledger owners reported losing a combined $604,000 in crypto from hardware wallets they said were purchased at authorized retailer Virgin Megastore in Dubai.

articles.title: LeBron James sues startup over viral AI ad allegedly exploiting his likeness
articles.description: LeBron James sued an AI-powered sports betting startup over alleged unauthorized use of his likeness.

articles.title: OpenAI bugging case defendant Alfozan set for trial in January
articles.description: Abdulrahman Alfozan has been held without bail since his arrest in October, after prosecutors said he planted a listening device in an OpenAI conference room.

CFTC nominee questions public benefit of prediction markets as legal fight grows

articles.title: Japan exports in October surge 20.5%, beating estimates on robust chip shipments
articles.description: Semiconductor shipments spiked almost 50% year on year.

articles.title: Nvidia board rejects Huang comeback despite record $116B quarter
articles.description: Nvidia beat Wall Street’s revenue expectations by 5.6% and issued a stronger-than-expected sales forecast, while its board resisted growing calls for Jensen Huang’s reinstatement.

articles.title: Why Microsoft Thinks Smaller, Cheaper AI Can Beat Claude and GPT
articles.description: Microsoft's new coding, cybersecurity and image models challenge bigger rivals on performance and price. The company's bet is that doing one job exceptionally well matters more than doing absolutely everything.

articles.title: Nvidia Board Shuts Down Jensen Huang Comeback, Launches Search for New CEO
articles.description: Nvidia's board rejected a comeback for its ousted co-founder as it hired a search firm, backed interim CEO Colette Kress, and tightened oversight of chip exports to China.
